Interval calibration benchmark on simulated data

Source: R/validation.R
benchmark_coverage.Rd

Fits spec on 30 years of simulate_lc_dgp() data and scores predictive draws for the next h years, over n_rep replicates.

Usage

benchmark_coverage(
  spec,
  n_rep = 10,
  h = 10,
  n_draws = 300,
  n_train = 30,
  prep = NULL
)

Arguments

spec

Model specification.

n_rep

Replicates.

h

Horizon.

n_draws

Draws per forecast.

n_train

Training years.

Value

A data.table with coverage by horizon and a summary list in attribute "summary" (cov95_mean, cov95_min, cov80_mean, cov50_mean).
